The average causal effect of the Neighbors message on 2006 primary turnout, for a 25-year-old voter, is about **0.081** (8.1 percentage points).

I fit an OLS regression of `primary2006` on message indicators (Control as the baseline) and age, with age computed as 2006 − `yearofbirth`.
